answer: To spin up a sybil, an attacker needs one relic per fake reputation slot, so forging N participants costs N devices plus stake slashed on any mismatch—far pricier than the ocean of free throwaway accounts they hoped to flood the network with. Each agent must stake a unique hardware relic keyed to a physical device fingerprint, and every transaction appends a signed thread to a public ledger. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
